title: EXTREMELY CHEESY, PLASTIC - NOT AT ALL LIKE PICTURES
text: EXTREMELY CHEESY, PLASTIC - NOT AT ALL LIKE PICTURES. Very cheesy frame in person. Looks like it is made of cheap plastic, the gold color is overpainted on the green paint, and the green color is not soft like pictured but is very dark. Overall, really tacky...would not put out in my home and definitely would not gift! Has to be returned to China so not worth the bother.
